topic: Ch. 4’s reference to spatial location in Ch. 8
claim: “for further discussion of spatial location and extension of the roles to the dimension of time, see Ch. 8, §§5–6”.
evidence_summary: Ch. 8, §4 (p. 679) is “Location and change of location in space”, §5 (p. 690) is “Spatial extent and scalar change”, and §6 (p. 694) is “Temporal location”.
finding: Change §§5–6 to §§4–6. References into Ch. 8, §4 also point one place too high at Ch. 4 p. 305 (CG-0171) and Ch. 8 p. 665 [1ix]. That fits a late renumbering of §4, but doesn’t establish one.
inference: Does the cited range include spatial location?
